title: Dify data model
description: Canonical entity definitions, derived from the SQLAlchemy ORM in api/models/ — the shape the database actually has. Every $defs key is a live __tablename__; x-source cites the ORM class. Field types map SQLAlchemy column types to JSON Schema; x-enums names the StrEnum a column is constrained by and cites where that enum is declared. Request and response payload shapes are NOT defined here: the repository generates its own API contract (api/dev/generate_swagger_specs.py -> api/openapi/markdown/*.md, and packages/contracts/generated/**/*.gen.ts), and that generated contract is authoritative for payloads.
